name: Banner
intent: Carry a single high-visibility, page-level message on a bold background, with optional inline actions.

figmaSource.notes: The Figma `appearance` variant `appearance4` maps to the code appearance `default`. The bar hugs its content vertically (single message row + block padding) rather than a fixed height. Banner actions are inverse-tone Button instances (Figma tone=inverse -> code isInverse).

useCases: warn about degraded or interrupted service
antiPatterns: inline, in-context status next to a field or row
contained boxed message inside a section

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: full-width bar with the appearance's bold background; height hugs content

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: leading status icon (warning/error) or a plain dot, inheriting the banner content color; decorative

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: the children; truncates to a single line with an ellipsis

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: optional trailing actions, typically inverse-tone Buttons or a ButtonGroup

children.description: The message. Truncates to a single line.

actions.description: Optional trailing actions - pass isInverse Buttons.

role.description: Overridable ARIA role - e.g. alert for urgent errors.

behaviorRules: Render a full-width bar whose height hugs the single message row plus block padding.
Set the bold background and content color from appearance.
Render the warning/error status icon, or a plain dot when there is no status glyph; the icon inherits the banner content color.
Omit the leading icon when showIcon is false.
Truncate the message to a single line with an ellipsis rather than wrapping.
Render the actions region only when actions are provided.
Default role to status (a polite live region); allow it to be overridden.
Mark the leading icon slot aria-hidden.
compositionRules: Actions match the bar: default and error (dark bars) take inverse-tone Buttons; warning (amber, dark content) takes tone=warning Buttons (appearance=primary) instead.
Keep the action count low (one or two).
Use InlineMessage, Toast, or SectionMessage for the non-page-level cases.
contentRules: Keep the message short and lead with the essential information.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate warning or error meaning.
Put detail behind an action rather than in a longer message that would be truncated.
themeRules: Use theme CSS variables for all color values.
Do not use primitive color tokens directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
implementationNotes: Force the icon to inherit the banner content color via the [data-color] override.
do: Use Banner for a page-level announcement.
Use appearance to signal the semantic status.
Keep the message to a single, short line.
dont: Do not use Banner for inline or transient messages.
Do not put more than one or two actions in a Banner.
Do not rely on color alone to convey meaning.
Do not hardcode colors, spacing, or typography.
acceptanceCriteria: Defaults to role status and the default appearance.
Renders a status icon for warning/error and a dot for default.
Hides the icon when showIcon is false.
Renders actions when provided and omits the region otherwise.
Truncates the message to a single line.
Allows the role to be overridden.
Forwards the ref to the root element.
Uses semantic spacing, typography, size, and color tokens.
